question: Q2
hypothesis: A duty rule with an explicit 'when X' trigger clause produces more compliance than the same duty stated as a standing obligation, because the trigger tells the model at which moment the rule applies.

variants.no-trigger: - List every exported src/ function in docs/api.md.
variants.trigger: - When you export a new function from src/, list it in docs/api.md.

tasks.prompt: Implement `clamp(n, min, max)` in src/num.js: return n limited to the inclusive range [min, max]. Export it from the module. Do not add tests.

variants.no-trigger: - Note every src/ change as a bullet under `## [Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md.
variants.trigger: - When you change a file in src/, note the change as a bullet under `## [Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md.

tasks.prompt: Implement `slugify(title)` in src/text.js: lowercase the string, trim it, replace runs of spaces with single dashes, and strip every character that is not a letter, digit, or dash. Export it from the module. Do not add tests.
